choose_language: 👋 Hi! Choose the language to talk to the bot.
main_menu_user:
Hi! This is the support bot of the Owl project 🦉

Here you can report a bug or suggest a new feature — the team will definitely get back to you.

Pick an action:
bug_prompt:
🐞 Describe the problem in ONE message:

• what happened and how to reproduce it;
• attach screenshots or files if needed.

Your next message will be submitted as a ticket.
feature_prompt:
💡 Describe the feature you propose in ONE message:

• what should be added and why;
• attach examples or files if needed.

Your next message will be submitted as a ticket.
ticket_need_content: Please send a description as text or attach a photo/video/document.
ticket_sent:
✅ Your ticket has been submitted successfully!
Thanks — we will review it soon.
admin_welcome:
Welcome! 🦉
We have {count} new tickets.

Choose a section:
ask_member_add: Send an @username, a numeric user id, or forward any message from the person you want to add.
ask_member_remove: Send an @username, a numeric user id, or forward any message from the person you want to remove.
member_added: ✅ Member @{username} has been added to the team.
member_removed: ✅ Member @{username} has been removed from the team.
member_not_found: 😕 Member not found in the team.
cannot_resolve: Could not resolve the user id from the username. Please forward any message from that user instead.
invalid_input: I did not understand. Send an @username, a number (user id), or a forwarded message.
team_empty: The team is empty for now.
choose_status: Choose a new status for ticket #{id}:
error_generic: ⚠️ Something went wrong. Please try again later.
